title: Dungeon Crawler Carl — Floor One
adaptationNote: Focused playable slice of Book 1. Combat numbers, item stats, enemy variants, encounter composition, and rewards are game adaptations; this is not a canonical rules or loot table. Personal clothing and accessories are represented without combat bonuses; any item mechanics added later are adaptations.

skills.name: Punch
skills.description: A close unarmed strike. Barefoot presentation is part of Carl's opening appearance.
skills.sourceNote: Unarmed melee is represented with a simple tactical action; its damage value is game tuning.

skills.name: Powerful Strike
skills.description: Carl channels a stronger unarmed hit. Fixed tactical damage adapts a described damage-multiplying skill.
skills.loreStatus: named ability; combat effect and value adapted
skills.sourceNote: Existing source ID: ability.carl_powerful_strike. No complete canonical rank table is established.

skills.name: Improvised Bomb
skills.description: A tactical explosive attack inspired by Carl's improvised explosives; blast radius and damage are game adaptations.
skills.sourceNote: Based on the existing ability.carl_bomb concept; exact Floor 1 tactical implementation is authored for this game.

skills.name: Magic Missile
skills.description: Donut's ranged arcane projectile. Spells spend mana; tactical damage is adapted.
skills.sourceNote: Existing source ID: ability.donut_magic_missile. Secondary summaries support early mana cost; this does not assert an unsupported rank progression.

skills.name: Claw
skills.description: A basic close attack for a cat. Its inclusion and tactical value are game-authored abstractions.
skills.sourceNote: Generic cat action; not asserted as a named novel ability.

items.name: Health Tonic
items.description: Restores health. Amount and availability are adapted from the archived starter catalog.

items.name: Mega Tonic
items.description: Restores a larger amount of health. Amount and availability are adaptations.

items.name: Mana Draught
items.description: Restores mana. This Floor 1 item and its amount are game-authored.

items.name: Coolant Bomb
items.description: A small thrown coolant charge. Tactical damage and availability are adaptations. Its damage behavior is not enabled by this combat schema.

items.name: Oil Flask
items.description: A thrown flask adapted from the archived item catalog; tactical effect is simplified. Its damage behavior is not enabled by this combat schema.

items.name: Fire Bomb
items.description: A compact explosive. Effect and availability are adapted from the archived item catalog. Its damage behavior is not enabled by this combat schema.

items.name: Cleansing Tonic
items.description: A restorative tonic. Its numeric effect and availability are adaptations.

enemies.name: Hoarder Elite
enemies.loreStatus: boss variant adaptation; not an asserted canonical stat block

false-guild.speaker: Goblin sign crew
false-guild.text: The painted guild sign promises help. Something about the alley feels staged.
false-guild.note: Original paraphrase; encounter framing follows the false guild setup.

mordecai.speaker: Mordecai
mordecai.text: Welcome to the Tutorial Guild. Take a breath, learn the basics, then choose your route carefully.
mordecai.note: Original short NPC line; Mordecai is a guide, not a deployable party member.

hoarder.speaker: Hoarder
hoarder.text: The nest is crowded with stolen things. Keep your eyes on the Scatterers.
hoarder.note: Original encounter prompt; no novel dialogue copied.

tally.speaker: Tally
tally.text: You can rest here and sort out what you found before heading back into the halls.

workshop.speaker: Workshop goblin
workshop.text: The machines rattle, the fuses hiss, and the crew has noticed you.
workshop.note: Original encounter prompt; room layout and combat are adaptations.

juicer.speaker: Gym announcer
juicer.text: The gym is still open. Step into the ring if you want to settle this the hard way.
juicer.note: Original prompt; tactical encounter is adapted.

meadow-lark.speaker: Meadow Lark
meadow-lark.text: Stay alert near the stair. The noise below carries farther than you think.
meadow-lark.note: Original paraphrase; encounter placement is adapted.

ball-of-swine.speaker: Dungeon announcer
ball-of-swine.text: The descent is open. Something enormous is waiting below.
ball-of-swine.note: Original transition line; descent and battle pacing are adaptations.
